summary: The University of Toronto's Department of Materials Science and Engineering puts forward international master's and PhD students for the Ontario Graduate Scholarship, worth C$5,000 a session for two or three consecutive sessions. You need a valid Canadian study permit. The department's deadline for 2027–28 is 1 March 2027.
meta_description: Toronto's materials science department nominates international students for the Ontario Graduate Scholarship, C$5,000 a session. Deadline 1 March 2027.
covers: C$5,000 per session for two or three consecutive sessions, C$10,000 to C$15,000 in all.
eligibility: International master's or doctoral students in the department, with a valid study permit.
Each graduate unit may send only one to three international applications to the School of Graduate Studies, which decides centrally.
how_to_apply: Apply through the University of Toronto School of Graduate Studies' OGS process, following the department's instructions.
Submit by the department's deadline of 1 March 2027 at 11:59 pm Eastern Time.
watch_out: Only one to three international applications go forward from the department, so the department picks its strongest candidates first.
The award is a partial contribution and does not cover full international fees.
A study permit is required, so this suits students already admitted or enrolled.
documents: An OGS application through the School of Graduate Studies
Proof of a valid study permit

faq.q: Can international students get the Ontario Graduate Scholarship at Toronto MSE?
faq.a: Yes, with a valid study permit; the department can put forward one to three international applications.
C$5,000 a session for two or three consecutive sessions.
1 March 2027 at 11:59 pm Eastern Time, for 2027–28.
